newsitem.title: MEXICO: Sanyo, Mabe inaugurate expanded Mexico plant.
newsitem.headline: Sanyo, Mabe inaugurate expanded Mexico plant.

text.p: Mexican President Ernesto Zedillo opened on Thursday an expansion to a compressor plant built as a joint venture between Mabe SA de CV and Sanyo Electric Co Ltd.
The expansion cost $96 million and will employ 1,115 people in the city of San Luis Potosi, 220 miles northwest of Mexico City, a company statement said.
The joint venture is known as Mabe Sanyo Compressors (MSC) and will specialize in manufacturing 2.3 million compressors a year for refrigeration.

Mabe contributed 65 percent of the share capital, and Sanyo the remaining 35 percent. Mabe is a privately owned Mexican producer of home appliances which also has factories in Venezuela, Colombia and Ecuador.
MSC aims to export 57 percent of production.
